_comment: Copy to config.json on the Pi Zero (git-ignored). No secrets live here — the Zero never authenticates to the VPS; the device secret is on the Pico only.

nfc._mock_note: set driver to 'mock' and add "codes": ["AABBCCDD"] to test without hardware

ui._console_note: set driver to 'console' for headless bring-up

_ota: OTA (design #144). The Zero fetches its OWN signed firmware over WiFi/HTTPS (OTA only; still makes no access decisions). verify_key = DOOR_FW_VERIFY_KEY (spki DER base64, PUBLIC, from the vault). ota_device_secret = this device's entry in OTA_DEVICE_SECRETS on the socket-server.
